announcement.quote: We release the DeepSeek LLM 7B/67B, including both base and chat models, to the public.

source.title: DeepSeek LLM README
source.quote: DeepSeek LLM 67B Chat exhibits outstanding performance in coding (HumanEval Pass@1: 73.78) and mathematics (GSM8K 0-shot: 84.1, Math 0-shot: 32.6).

scores.note: HellaSwag is reported only for the Base model in this table, not the Chat model used for the other legacy scores above.

releases.notes: DeepSeek's first-generation dense (non-MoE) model, 7B and 67B released together; 67B is the flagship. Exact release day not confirmed from a primary DeepSeek source, so recorded at month precision (widely reported as Nov 29, 2023). No ARC-Challenge or WinoGrande figures were found in the official README or paper for this model.

announcement.title: DeepSeek-V2.5
announcement.quote: DeepSeek-V2.5 is an upgraded version that combines DeepSeek-V2-Chat and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct. The new model integrates the general and coding abilities of the two previous versions.

sources.title: DeepSeek API news index (lists DeepSeek-V2.5 Release 2024/09/05)

announcement.quote: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V3.1

announcement.title: DeepSeek-V3.1
announcement.quote: DeepSeek-V3.1 is a hybrid model that supports both thinking mode and non-thinking mode.

releases.notes: First hybrid think/non-think DeepSeek-V model; scores recorded here are the thinking-mode configuration.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp

announcement.title: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp
announcement.quote: We are excited to announce the official release of DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, an experimental version of our model.

scores.config: AIME 2025, reasoning mode w/o tool use

releases.notes: Experimental release introducing DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA); DeepSeek deliberately aligned its training configuration with V3.1-Terminus to isolate the effect of sparse attention, so scores are close to V3.1's.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V3.2

announcement.title: DeepSeek-V3.2
announcement.quote: We introduce DeepSeek-V3.2, a model that harmonizes high computational efficiency with superior reasoning and agent performance.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models (technical report)

releases.notes: Official successor to V3.2-Exp; DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale (API-only, maximum reasoning) was launched the same day as a separate reasoning-maximized variant, not recorded here as it targets research/eval use rather than general availability.

releases.name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro

announcement.title: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release
announcement.quote: DeepSeek-V4 Preview is officially live & open-sourced! Welcome to the era of cost-effective 1M context length.

scores.note: Scores are from the current (post-GA, V4-Pro-0813) model card, which reports the DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max configuration; the model was first made available at preview on 2026-04-24 and reached GA as V4-Pro-0813 on 2026-08-13.

releases.notes: 1.6T-parameter (49B active) MoE model; DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B/13B active) launched the same day as a smaller tier and is excluded here. Preview weights went live and open-sourced 2026-04-24; reasoning-effort modes (low/high/max) and the V4-Pro-0813 checkpoint shipped at GA on 2026-08-13. deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner API aliases were retired in favor of deepseek-v4-* on 2026-07-24.
